full_judgment: a. Plaintiff had been owner and possessor of property measuring an area of .49 acres, more or less, 26 katas and 14 chattaks of Cadestral Survey plot no.250 (in part) under Mouza Dhanmondi corresponding to State Acquisition plot no.22 and 23 recorded in State Acquisition Khatian No.54. Plaintiff had been exercising ownership and acts of possession on the property including building and all other structures standing thereon peacefully and uninterruptedly.
